authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "Experimental changes remain quarantined until gates pass." N-Lab runs shadow work that cannot execute until gates pass, so its ceiling is draft.
Boundary quote: "Experimental changes remain quarantined until gates pass." Quarantined experimental work that proposes but cannot execute maps to draft in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Runs shadow topologies, ablations, red-team tests, and counterfactuals."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to N-Lab.

memoryPlanes.basis: Role quote: "Runs shadow topologies, ablations, red-team tests, and counterfactuals." Shadow runs execute in working scope; counterfactuals are prospective by definition in the Section 3.3 memory vocabulary.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Runs shadow topologies, ablations, red-team tests, and counterfactuals." Shadow-test and ablation results are recorded as artifacts.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for N-Lab.

paperBoundary: Experimental changes remain quarantined until gates pass.
